neighbours.label: 'then' (or the next-step connector) that starts the following step in a procedure or game rules ('…for three weeks then test…'), as against the same steps without a sequencing word
fire: Soak the beans overnight then drain them in the morning.
Keep the plant in the dark for two weeks then move it to a window.
Run on the treadmill for ten minutes then stretch your legs.
Let the dough rise for an hour then shape it into loaves.
Avoid sugar for a month then add small amounts back slowly.
Leave the paint to dry for a day then apply a second coat.
Shuffle the deck three times then deal seven cards to each player.
Heat the solution for five minutes then let it cool on the bench.

Keep the plant in a bright window during the winter months.

The dough rose for an hour in the warm kitchen.
She avoided sugar for a month last spring.
The paint dried quickly in the warm afternoon sun.
The deck had fifty-two cards and two jokers.
